comparison.objective: Adjust an enclosure latch’s threaded grip length and close its wing cam.
comparison.physical_skill: Threaded adjustment followed by cam closure to establish compression.
comparison.success_condition: Gap below 1 mm, clamp above 20 N, handle at least 175 degrees, hands-off for 20 seconds.
comparison.reason: This adjusts compression and closes a cam, but does not require concentric driver/wrench countertorque or preservation of a stop through repeated articulation.
